note: The security and compliance control register for a Cognition.X deployment, reviewed at v0.57.0. Each control names the level it belongs to (platform = the software as built; federal, state, parish/county, local, district = what an adopting hall, school or program office meets), the requirement and its source, who owns it, its status, the evidence (a test, a smoke check, a CI step, a document or a file the tests confirm exists) and the next step. NOT LEGAL ADVICE: sources are cited as commonly published; verify each with the agency or counsel before relying on it. Louisiana is the flagship; the fifty-state compliance layer carries the state-level facts for the rest.

levels.platform: the software as built and tested
levels.federal: United States law and agency rules
levels.state: state statute and agency policy (Louisiana as the flagship; the fifty-state layer for the rest)
levels.parish: parish or county government, its IT and its fire marshal
levels.local: municipal ordinance and the host site
levels.district: the local education agency (school board) and its policies

statuses.met: held by the software or by a document the tests confirm, or done by the adopter with the platform's support
statuses.partial: the software's part is done; the adopter's part, or a second wave of the software's, remains
statuses.open: nothing built yet beyond this line in the roadmap

controls.title: No network egress from any app
controls.requirement: Every app makes no request of any kind after load; a Content-Security-Policy with connect-src 'none' makes the browser enforce it.
controls.source: CIS Controls v8 4.x (secure configuration); NIST CSF PR.DS
controls.next: Keep; re-audit on every release (CI).

controls.title: No third-party resources
controls.requirement: Typefaces and every asset are embedded; no font, script, image or style is fetched from a third party.
controls.source: GDPR-style data-minimisation; state student-privacy 'no advertising / no tracking' clauses
controls.next: Keep.

controls.title: No code from text
controls.requirement: No eval, no Function constructor (one documented CSP probe in the Education OS), no inline event handlers introduced by the runtime.
controls.source: CIS 16 (application software security)
controls.next: Keep.

controls.title: Signing key is non-extractable
controls.requirement: The Records Office private key is a non-extractable WebCrypto key held in IndexedDB; only the public key travels; a pre-v0.57.0 office migrates once and its bytes are removed from local storage.
controls.source: NIST SP 800-57 key management; CIS 3.10
controls.next: Hosted deployments: consider platform authenticators (WebAuthn) for the office in a later wave.

controls.title: Release integrity verifiable
controls.requirement: SHA-256 sums of every built app are committed and regenerated by CI; adopters verify a file they were handed with sha256sum -c.
controls.source: CIS 2.x (software inventory and integrity); NIST SSDF PS.3
controls.next: Sign releases (Sigstore / git tag signatures) in a later wave.

controls.title: Reproducible builds
controls.requirement: A fresh clone plus Python 3 rebuilds every app byte-for-byte; CI fails on drift.
controls.source: NIST SSDF PW.6; SLSA build provenance (aspiration)

evidence.ref: Apps must be byte-identical to their committed builds

controls.next: Publish SLSA provenance when releases are signed.

controls.title: Vulnerability disclosure policy
controls.requirement: A SECURITY.md names the reporting channel, response times and the threat model.
controls.source: CISA VDP template; ISO 29147
controls.next: Enable GitHub private vulnerability reporting on the repository (repository setting).

controls.title: Software bill of materials
controls.requirement: The apps have no runtime dependencies; build-time tooling is Python 3 standard library; dev-time browser tests use Playwright and axe-core.
controls.source: EO 14028 SBOM expectations; NTIA minimum elements
controls.next: Emit a CycloneDX SBOM from the build (tools/sbom.py) listing the embedded fonts and the dev toolchain.

controls.title: Local-only storage with disclosure
controls.requirement: Everything a person enters stays in the browser's local storage under a namespaced key; a Data & privacy notice in every app lists the keys and erases them.
controls.source: FERPA §99.31 (no disclosure occurs); COPPA (no online collection by an operator); state student-privacy statutes
controls.next: Keep.

controls.title: Consent-gated, aggregate evidence export
controls.requirement: Evidence exports are behind a consent step, carry per-track counts only, and are sent by a person.
controls.source: FERPA de-identification (§99.31(b)); state statutes on aggregate data
controls.next: Keep.

controls.title: Right to access, correct and erase
controls.requirement: Export shows everything; edit or re-import corrects; remove one learner or erase everything from the notice.
controls.source: GDPR-style rights; the Education OS's rectification-and-erasure stance
controls.next: Keep.

controls.title: Data minimisation for minors
controls.requirement: Nickname guidance; no birth date, contact detail or photograph asked for anywhere.
controls.source: COPPA 16 CFR 312; state under-13 rules
controls.next: Keep.

controls.title: Untrusted input sanitized
controls.requirement: Pasted ledgers, trust lists and revocation lists are third-party data and are coerced to shape before use.
controls.source: OWASP ASVS V5 (input validation)
controls.next: Keep.

controls.title: WCAG 2.2 AA
controls.requirement: Zero WCAG-tagged violations across 45 audited views; keyboard-complete; documented best-practice deviations.
controls.source: ADA Title II web rule (28 CFR 35, WCAG 2.1 AA by 2026/2027); Section 508; state digital-accessibility standards
controls.next: Re-audit the new dialogs and the studio at the next audit run.

controls.title: Signed, offline-verifiable records
controls.requirement: Credential records are ECDSA-signed and verify offline with tamper detection; a record states what was witnessed.
controls.source: NIST FIPS 186 (ECDSA); records integrity expectations
controls.next: W3C VC / Open Badges 3.0 envelopes — roadmap step 6.

controls.title: Records custody statement for public bodies
controls.requirement: A hall or school that keeps a ledger holds a record under its own retention schedule; the export is the custody mechanism.
controls.source: Louisiana Public Records Law R.S. 44:1 et seq.; state records-retention schedules
controls.next: Add an 'export all for records custody' one-click bundle (ledger + issued records + trust list) in the Louisiana app.

controls.title: Youth hazard orders in the simulation studio
controls.requirement: Every trades scenario names the Hazardous Occupations Orders and OSHA rules that keep minors off the live task; the studio law forbids energized, suspended or moving work live in class.
controls.source: FLSA 29 CFR 570 Subpart E (HO 7, 8, 14, 16, 17); OSHA 1910.333; La. R.S. 23:151 et seq.
controls.next: Add the state employment-certificate requirement to the Trade Hall setup checklist (LAUNCH pack) in a later wave.

controls.title: Honesty stances held by tests
controls.requirement: Simulation ≠ certification; profiles are never diagnoses; no union local numbers; credentials at exactly fifty witnessed checks.
controls.source: Consumer-protection and deceptive-claims norms; the platform's own charter
controls.next: Keep.

controls.title: Durable learner state and quota handling
controls.requirement: Ledgers live in localStorage, which is size-limited and silently lossy; write failures are surfaced, not yet durable.
controls.source: CIS 11 (data recovery)
controls.next: Roadmap prompt 9: IndexedDB for the ledger with a one-time migration; quota errors reported to the user.

controls.title: Hosting hardening guide
controls.requirement: When a district hosts the apps over https, each gets its own origin; the guide should set TLS, HSTS, the same CSP as a header and no analytics.
controls.source: CIS 12/13; OWASP secure headers
controls.next: Write docs/HOSTING.md with nginx/Apache header examples and a Playwright check that the hosted copy behaves like the file.

controls.title: FERPA — education records
controls.requirement: A school that keeps ledgers on its own devices holds its own education records; no vendor custody occurs; disclosures happen only by a person exporting a file.
controls.source: 20 U.S.C. §1232g; 34 CFR Part 99
controls.next: Attach the data-processing statement to the district's own FERPA policy file.

controls.title: COPPA — under-13 collection
controls.requirement: No operator collects anything online from a child; an adopter that hosts and adds collection takes on COPPA duties then.
controls.next: Keep the hosted copy free of any collection; re-review if a login is ever added.

controls.title: FLSA child-labor hazardous occupations
controls.requirement: Minors under 18 stay off HO-listed tasks; student-learner exemptions need a written agreement.
controls.source: 29 CFR 570 Subpart E
controls.next: Each Trade Hall station posts its youth line; the hall keeps the written student-learner agreements where an exemption is used.

controls.title: OSHA — training environments
controls.requirement: Halls follow OSHA general-industry and construction rules for any live station; OSHA 10 for trainees is the customary floor.
controls.source: 29 CFR 1910 / 1926; OSHA Outreach Training
controls.next: Add OSHA 10 as a hall-readiness requirement in the LAUNCH pack's Trade Hall checklist.

controls.title: ADA Title II web rule
controls.requirement: Public entities' web content and apps must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (2026 for large, 2027 for small entities); the apps meet 2.2 AA.
controls.source: 28 CFR Part 35 Subpart H
controls.next: Keep the audit current; the adopter's own site that links to the apps must also comply.

controls.title: K–12 cybersecurity guidance
controls.requirement: CISA's K–12 guidance is voluntary; districts increasingly require vendors to answer it.
controls.source: K–12 Cybersecurity Act of 2021; CISA K–12 toolkit
controls.next: Use this register as the vendor answer; add a CISA-aligned summary table in wave 2.

controls.title: Student information privacy (Louisiana Act 677 / R.S. 17:3914)
controls.requirement: Districts may not share personally identifiable student information with a vendor without a written agreement; the platform holds none, but a district adopting it still documents that.
controls.source: La. R.S. 17:3914; the fifty-state privacy domain
controls.next: Sign the state-specific data agreement from the compliance layer with the district; keep this statement attached.

controls.title: Breach notification
controls.requirement: Every state has a statute; the realistic incident is a lost device or a misdirected export; the clock starts at discovery; regulator notice thresholds vary.
controls.source: La. R.S. 51:3071 et seq. (60 days; AG within 10 days); the fifty-state breach domain
controls.next: Name the incident lead and the district's reporting line in the runbook before the first cohort.

controls.title: State and local cybersecurity training
controls.requirement: Louisiana requires annual cybersecurity training for state and local government employees; a parish-run hall's staff fall under the parish's program.
controls.source: La. Act 250 (2020), R.S. 42:1267; OTS Information Security Policy
controls.next: Add a one-page 'device and data hygiene for hall staff' to the trainer track; parish staff take the parish's own course.

controls.title: Background checks for adults with minors
controls.requirement: Every assessor, mentor and volunteer with unsupervised access is checked; the fifty-state layer gives the law and cost per state.
controls.next: Keep the check log with the hall's records.

controls.title: Mandated reporting
controls.requirement: Louisiana makes every adult a mandated reporter; training is expected for those working with minors.
controls.source: La. Ch.C. art. 603, 609
controls.next: Include the mandated-reporter line in the trainer track's first session.

controls.title: Child labor — employment certificates
controls.requirement: Minors under 18 need an employment certificate (work permit) for paid work in Louisiana; unpaid classroom studio time is not employment, a paid apprenticeship is.
controls.source: La. R.S. 23:151 et seq.
controls.next: Add the certificate step to the union-partnership track when a placement becomes paid.

controls.title: Public records and retention
controls.requirement: A parish- or school-held ledger is a public record subject to retention schedules and, on request, disclosure with student information redacted.
controls.source: La. R.S. 44:1 et seq.; State Archives retention schedules
controls.next: Map the ledger, the issued records and the evidence exports to the district's retention schedule; keep the custody statement on file.

controls.title: State digital accessibility standard
controls.requirement: Louisiana adopts WCAG 2.1 AA for state web content; parishes and districts follow the ADA rule.
controls.source: La. R.S. 39:302 (OTS accessibility); ADA Title II
controls.next: Keep.

controls.title: Procurement and open-source use
controls.requirement: Apache-2.0 code and CC BY 4.0 content with no per-seat licence; a public body still follows its procurement policy for any paid support.
controls.source: La. R.S. 39:1551 et seq. (procurement code); district policy
controls.next: Provide the licence summary with any support contract.

controls.title: Parish IT acceptable-use and device policy
controls.requirement: Hall devices running the apps are parish assets under the parish's policy: screen lock, disk encryption, no shared accounts, backups by export.
controls.source: Parish IT policy; CIS 4.x, 3.6 (encryption at rest)
controls.next: Write the hall's device sheet: encryption on, auto-lock 5 minutes, one profile per assessor, weekly ledger export to the parish share.

controls.title: Fire code and occupancy for a Trade Hall
controls.requirement: A hall in a parish-owned room meets the fire marshal's occupancy, egress and extinguisher rules; the studio law keeps hot, suspended and moving work out of the room.
controls.source: Louisiana State Fire Marshal (R.S. 40:1561 et seq.); NFPA 101 as adopted
controls.next: Fire-marshal walkthrough before the first session; post occupancy; extinguisher types matched to the stations.

controls.title: Insurance and liability
controls.requirement: General liability and, where apprentices are paid, workers' compensation; volunteers covered by the parish's or the nonprofit's policy.
controls.source: Parish risk management; La. R.S. 23:1021 et seq.
controls.next: Confirm coverage in writing before the first cohort.

controls.title: Parish approval and agreements
controls.requirement: A memorandum of understanding between the program office, the parish and the district names the room, the schedule, the custody of records and the incident line.
controls.source: Parish council / school board authority
controls.next: Draft the MOU from the three templates; put it on the next agenda.

controls.title: Youth program supervision ratios and check-in
controls.requirement: Hall sessions with minors keep the district's supervision ratio, a sign-in sheet, and two-adult rule.
controls.source: District and municipal youth-program rules
controls.next: Use the LAUNCH pack's session record; add ratio and two-adult lines.

controls.title: Municipal facility and permit rules
controls.requirement: A city-owned or leased room may need a use permit; events (a public showcase) may need an assembly permit.
controls.source: Municipal ordinances
controls.next: Check with the city clerk when the room is not parish- or district-owned.

controls.title: District data-governance policy and DPA
controls.requirement: Districts require a signed data-privacy agreement (often the SDPC national form) and list approved tools; the platform's statement answers the agreement's exhibits.
controls.source: District policy; Student Data Privacy Consortium NDPA
controls.next: Submit the statement with the district's DPA; ask the district to list the apps as approved offline tools.

controls.title: District security questionnaire
controls.requirement: Districts ask vendors for controls (encryption, access, incident response, SBOM); this register and SECURITY.md are the answer set.
controls.source: District vendor-risk process; CISA K–12
controls.next: Answer with the register; note the open items honestly.

controls.title: Transcript and credential recognition
controls.requirement: A platform credential is recognised on a transcript only by district decision; the district compact track names the steps.
controls.source: District policy; LDOE Jump Start / IBC lists
controls.next: Bring the credential list to the review board and the district's CTE office together.
